Ending a meeting no longer leaves the window in a four-column layout, and a dropped connection no longer ends a recording.

- **The meeting screen never squeezes the sidebar in after you press End.** 0.32.1 kept it away only while the recording was being saved. A meeting that ended without a report, because it was too short or nothing was transcribed, still brought the sidebar back beside the coach. ⌘B still shows the sidebar when you want it.
- **A meeting that isn't kept goes back to Home and says why**, instead of leaving you on the stopped meeting screen: too short to save, or nothing was transcribed.
- **A save that fails now says so.** The meeting screen stays up so the transcript is still on screen, with an error message instead of what looked like a slow save.
- **Losing the network no longer ends a recording.** The recording keeps going and transcription reconnects.
